products.title: PQ wallet / account
products.description: No platform creation fee. Onchain enrollment gas is separate.

products.title: Browse and preview
products.description: Explore the catalog and supported configurations.

products.title: Standard QHook
products.description: No upfront platform fee for supported standard hooks. Deployment gas is separate.

products.title: QHooks Lab build
products.description: Supported-template configuration and export, subject to service limits. Not bespoke contract development.

products.title: QToken launch
products.rate: About $0.45 / launch (0.0002 ETH; 0.0007 BNB on BNB Chain)
products.description: Flat fee per launch, paid in the chain’s coin before the first launch transaction: 0.0002 ETH on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain and 0.0007 BNB on BNB Chain. Gas and liquidity are separate.

products.title: Small paid API request
products.description: Only designated small paid operations. Builds and launches keep their website price.

products.title: Trade in the terminal
products.rate: 1% of the trade, 30% of it back to you as cashback
products.description: Taken on the quote side of each terminal trade. 30% is cashback you claim in the terminal, 20% goes to whoever referred you (fixed on your first referred trade; QHooks keeps it if nobody did), and the rest goes to QHooks. Share your referral link from the terminal to earn 20% of the fees on your referrals' trades.

trading.scope: Supported launch pools only. Not all-market volume or token transfers.
trading.rateRounding: Protocol rate is rounded down to whole parts per million.
